summary: Practise LDI exposure analysis, hedge ratios and collateral planning. Review the five-day course and build decision-ready investment outputs.
lede: Liability-driven investment training helps pension analysts, actuaries and treasury professionals align portfolios with projected liability cash flows. They practise checking cash-flow projections, comparing asset and liability DV01, and calculating hedge ratios. Spreadsheet exercises also cover interest-rate and collateral stress, liquidity planning, portfolio monitoring and trustee-ready reporting to support investment and liquidity decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who assess pension or insurance liabilities, manage liability-aware portfolios, or review the liquidity and governance decisions that support LDI strategies.
modules: LDI Mandate and Liability Cash Flows
prerequisites: Working familiarity with fixed-income portfolios, pension or insurance liabilities, and bond duration is expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available.
